parameters.rateUnits: dimensionless activity, 0–1; not spikes or measured firing rates
parameters.operatingPoint: initial resting joint angle; explicit sensor-centering assumption

provenance.structure: exact BANC v888 IDs and one detector at a time; muscle actions are curated annotations
provenance.modalities: claw position and hook direction/velocity are population-level literature roles
provenance.unknown: exact-root tuning polarity, thresholds, gains, intrinsic dynamics, receptor effects, recruitment, force and inertia are uncalibrated
provenance.model: uniform population polarity hypotheses, centered rate states, tonic muscle drive and joint mechanics are declared choices
provenance.scope: one suspended LF femur–tibia joint; not whole-brain autonomy, gait, balance or locomotion

bodyDefaults.angleConvention: bend angle: straight=0; increasing=flexion; not anatomical inner angle
bodyDefaults.units: seconds/radians; torque, inertia, activation and stiffness are uncalibrated model units

findings.scientificInterpretation: The technical loop closes and responds causally to the actual joint. Neither root tuning, signed physiological circuit, nor force scale is calibrated. Mechanical return alone occurs in sensory_open and is not evidence of neural stabilization.
